attributeConditions.hdmi: Physically fitted HDMI sockets; additional FFC video connections are not counted.

geometryEvidence.summary: PCB outline, mounting holes and major connector envelopes reconstructed from the cited manufacturer design revision. CM5 is not fitted.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Authored reconstruction from official revision 2 KiCad geometry and connector reference models. Five components have source footprint XY dimensions and approximate heights. Nominal PCB thickness is 1.6 mm from the general KiCad field; the exported source stackup is 1.51 mm. Connector bodies are seated on the nominal PCB faces. Solder tails, traces and small electronics are omitted. B2B open-shell reference envelopes are reconstructed as closed bodies; cavity profiles, individual GPIO contacts and colors are illustrative. The source archive notes that some component models are approximate.

geometryEvidence.summary: PCB outline, mounting holes and major connector envelopes reconstructed from the cited manufacturer design revision. CM5 is not fitted.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Authored reconstruction from the manufacturer STEP dated 2025-02-25. PCB corner radius 3.5 mm is inferred from CAD tangent geometry, not a dimensioned callout. name: Waveshare CM5-NANO-A
description: Incomplete manufacturer CAD engineering reference for a bare CM5 carrier board. 55 × 40 mm nominal PCB; compute module, fitted GPIO header, inserted cards and accessories excluded.

catalog.sourceName: Waveshare product wiki, dimensioned drawing and manufacturer STEP dated 2025-03-13

attributeConditions.width: Nominal PCB width from the dimensioned manufacturer drawing; exact native CAD and connector overhangs are retained separately.
attributeConditions.length: Nominal PCB length from the dimensioned manufacturer drawing; connector overhangs excluded.
attributeConditions.hdmi: No HDMI socket fitted on CM5-NANO-A.
attributeConditions.mipi: Published product interfaces: two 22-pin 0.5 mm four-lane MIPI FPC connectors. Their actual connector bodies are absent from the supplied CAD.
attributeConditions.inputVoltage: DC power input; USB-C also supports image flashing.

geometryEvidence.summary: Incomplete manufacturer CAD engineering reference. Retained source surfaces preserve documented board geometry, but major connector bodies are absent or misassigned. Standard board without fitted GPIO header; source-shape bounds do not establish complete enclosure fit.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Incomplete manufacturer CAD engineering reference. The manufacturer STEP omits the actual bodies of both 22-pin MIPI FPC connectors and both 100-pin CM5 board-to-board sockets; source H1/H2 use small passive-component placeholders. Other connector bodies, including the microSD socket, are simplified. Missing connector body dimensions and placements are unresolved; reported dimensions cover retained source shapes, not the complete installed product envelope. Do not use these bounds to certify enclosure fit. Original manufacturer board CAD surfaces with the source PI1 fitted GPIO header excluded for standard CM5-NANO-A; colors are illustrative. CAD PCB is approximately 55.019 × 40.018 × 1.600 mm against the nominal 55 × 40 mm drawing. CM5, cooler, inserted cards, loose GPIO header, cables, battery and enclosure are excluded. Source CAD is a mechanical reference without manufacturing tolerances or certification of every hardware revision. The source microSD socket is a simplified single body; its internal contacts are not documented by the supplied CAD.

geometryEvidence.summary: Incomplete manufacturer CAD engineering reference. Retained source surfaces preserve documented board geometry, but major connector bodies are absent or misassigned. Standard board without fitted GPIO header; source-shape bounds do not establish complete enclosure fit.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Incomplete manufacturer CAD engineering reference. The manufacturer STEP omits the actual bodies of the RJ45 Ethernet connector, mini HDMI socket, microSD socket, both 22-pin MIPI FPC connectors and both 100-pin CM5 board-to-board sockets. Some other connector bodies are simplified or misassigned. Missing connector body dimensions and placements are unresolved; reported dimensions cover retained source shapes, not the complete installed product envelope. Do not use these bounds to certify enclosure fit. Original manufacturer board CAD surfaces with the fitted GPIO header of the source execution excluded for standard CM5-NANO-B; the pre-soldered CM5-NANO-B-M is not represented. CAD PCB is approximately 56.003 × 41.019 × 1.251 mm. The dimensioned drawing specifies 56 × 41 mm, conflicting with the sales specification of 55 × 41 mm; CAD is not scaled. CM5, cooler, inserted cards, loose GPIO header, cables, battery and enclosure are excluded. Source CAD is a mechanical reference without manufacturing tolerances or certification of every hardware revision.
